messages:
tara: Quick sync — ACME marketplace launch in 6 weeks. We need a single offer pattern that works for cloud marketplace private offers + HW partner bundle + SI professional services. I want a clear commit-to-discount ladder so field & SI can co-sell without conflicting SKUs.

alex: +1. Do we have a target commit size bandsheet yet?

tara: Not final. Thinking 10K / 50K / 200K commit bands but open to suggestions. Need to map to APAC vs NA pricing and HW kicker.

jordan: 10K for POC customers, 50K for rapid adoption, 200K for enterprise anchor — sounds sensible. For HW partners we should attach a fixed credit rather than % so it's easier to show on partner quotes.

ravi: Agree on fixed HW credit. Suggest: HW-credit = min(10% of commit, $25k) so it scales but caps. For SI, we should allow a rebate pool they draw from (pre-approved) vs direct discount on marketplace SKU.

emily: Field ops note — marketplace private offer flow requires a single SKU per offer. If SI needs a rebate, ops will create a companion invoice line. Keeps marketplace clean.

rebecca: Can we draft the mapping like this?
```
SKU -> Commit band -> Marketplace discount -> HW credit -> SI rebate pool
ACME-CORE-10 -> 10K -> 12% -> $5k -> $4k
ACME-CORE-50 -> 50K -> 20% -> $15k -> $12k
ACME-CORE-200 -> 200K -> 32% -> $25k -> $30k
```

alex: That layout helps. Two asks: 1) are we comfortable with 32% at 200K (margins), 2) how do renewals work — do we step down discounts?

tara: On margins — Redwood finance has buffer via reserved capacity margin. We'll confirm exact %. For renewals, plan is: initial commit gets full discount; renewal within 12 months gets 50% of original uplift unless they re-commit equal/greater. Add an early-renew bonus (2% off) if they commit before month 10.

ravi: Ops implication: marketplace private offers are time-limited. Need a policy doc for companion billing entries + SI rebate disbursement. I can draft.

emily: Also need an announcement cadence: joint-announce with HW partner on press day, SI-led field enablement week before. Marketing needs at least 3 weeks for co-branded assets.

jordan: For global pricing differences, let's use percentage off list + localized floor to avoid negative net. Example: floor price = list_local * 0.6. That handles FX and HW kicker variance.

rebecca: Quick check on automation: can we tag offers in marketplace with metadata: partner_id, si_program_id, hw_credit_tag — so billing and console can surface them?

emily: Yep we can. Console team: @deploy-bot can you create a stub label schema?

deploy-bot: automated: label schema created in staging -> [partner_id, si_program_id, hw_credit_tag, commit_band]. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/labels/pull/142

alex: Nice. Next steps: ravi to draft ops policy, rebecca to finalize SKU mapping, tara to confirm discount % with finance, emily to coordinate announcement calendar + marcom, jordan to validate floor pricing math. Can we reconvene Friday 10am PT?

tara: Friday 10am PT works for me. Please add agenda items: sample customer quotes, SI rebate flow diagram, marketing timeline.

rebecca: I'll upload a sample quote template to the partnership drive before EOD Thurs.

ravi: Draft ops doc in #docs will be linked in thread when ready.

emily: tagging marketing leads separately — will sync with partners on co-branding checklist. :party_parrot:

alex: thanks all — short thread but solid direction.
